description: This file defines a React component named RichEditor that implements a rich text editor based on the TipTap library. It includes setup and configuration of various editor extensions, handles image uploading via drag-and-drop, pasting, and URL input, and provides props for initial content, change handling, and image upload callbacks. It also renders a toolbar component and manages editor state.

methods.name: RichEditor
methods.description: React component that initializes and renders a TipTap-based rich text editor with image upload, paste, drag-and-drop support, and a modular toolbar. Manages editor lifecycle and content synchronization.
